Ch138 Thm 1

Theorem 1 (Chapter 138)

Subject: coding theory | ID: 81400

Proposition

Let Omega be a bounded domain with smooth boundary. Every continuous solution of the elliptic equation in Omega extends smoothly to the closure.

Proof

Step 1. Consider the symmetric operator \(U_{01380011}\) acting on the Lebesgue space. By the symmetric decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|U_{01380011}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_01380011\).

Step 2. Applying the hyperbolic interpolation theorem to \(A_{01380012}\), we obtain the norm bound in the mixed Lebesgue scale for the appropriate exponents.

Step 3. Using the primitive regularization, we obtain \(U_{01380013}\) as a limit in the operator norm topology of the Besov space.

Conclusion. Steps 1-3 yield the result via linear interpolation and the uniqueness of the decomposition.

Conclusion. Steps 1-3 yield the result via rational interpolation and the uniqueness of the decomposition.
